title: Khatu Shyam Mandir Darshan
style: 3D animated devotional movie style, Pixar quality, soft cinematic lighting, rich warm colours, no text, no letters, no writing

scenes.prompt: Close-up devotional darshan of the divine Sheesh (head only, no body, no flute) of Shri Khatu Shyam ji: a big divine dark face with large wide eyes and a moustache, a tall ornate golden mukut with peacock-feather and sun-ray motifs, framed in an oval of layered white, pink, blue and orange flower garlands and jewels, in a decorated sanctum, face in the middle of the frame, soft golden glow
scenes.tts: खाटू श्याम मंदिर, सीकर। बाबा श्याम के दर्शन कीजिए।
scenes.sub: Khatu Shyam Mandir, Sikar. Baba Shyam ke darshan kijiye.
scenes.animate: a very slow gentle camera push-in, the face stays still and serene, the soft golden glow gently pulses, a few petals drift in the foreground

scenes.prompt: A grand white marble Rajasthani temple with a tall shikhara and saffron flags in a small town, golden evening light, devotees' silhouettes far away in the courtyard
scenes.tts: ये मंदिर राजस्थान के सीकर ज़िले के खाटू गाँव में है।
scenes.sub: Ye mandir Rajasthan ke Sikar zile ke Khatu gaon mein hai.
scenes.animate: the saffron flags flutter gently in the evening breeze

scenes.prompt: Warm devotional scene of brass diyas, marigold garlands and fresh flowers laid before a decorated sanctum, soft golden light, no people
scenes.tts: मान्यता है, यहाँ बाबा श्याम का शीश पूजा जाता है।
scenes.sub: Manyata hai, yahan Baba Shyam ka sheesh pooja jata hai.
scenes.animate: the diya flames flicker softly and a few marigold petals drift down slowly

scenes.prompt: Close-up of the divine Sheesh (head only, no body, no flute) of Shri Khatu Shyam ji: a big divine dark face with large wide eyes and a moustache, a tall ornate golden mukut with peacock-feather and sun-ray motifs, framed in an oval of layered white, pink, blue and orange flower garlands and jewels, in a decorated sanctum, glowing diyas in the foreground
scenes.tts: हारे का सहारा, बाबा श्याम हमारा। जय श्री श्याम!
scenes.sub: Haare ka sahara, Baba Shyam hamara. Jai Shree Shyam!
scenes.animate: a very slow gentle camera push-in, the face stays still, the diya flames glow and flicker softly

scenes.tts: कल फिर नया दर्शन। लाइक, शेयर, सब्सक्राइब करें। जय खाटू श्याम!
scenes.sub: Kal phir naya darshan. Like, Share, Subscribe karein. Jai Khatu Shyam!
